rationale: C13 plausibly supplied a material template. Both orders follow the same compact commission machinery: establish and name the commission, prescribe its membership, state its functions, direct all executive departments and agencies to cooperate and furnish information and assistance, and provide for the commission's termination after its work or final report. Most decisively, the cooperation clause in C13 is nearly verbatim in the child, including the distinctive combination of “information and assistance,” “not inconsistent with law,” and “performance of its functions.” C07 contains substantially the same clause and termination machinery, while C18 has a similarly close overall sequence, but C13 provides the strongest combined literal and structural match.

shared_material.child_excerpt: All executive departments and agencies of the Federal Government are authorized and directed to cooperate with the Commission in its work and to furnish the Commission such information and assistance, not inconsistent with law, as it may require in the performance of its functions.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: All executive departments and agencies of the Federal Government are authorized and directed to cooperate with the Commission in its work and to furnish the Commission such information and assistance, not inconsistent with law, as it may require in the performance of its functions.
shared_material.explanation: This operative provision is effectively identical and contains a distinctive cluster of qualifications and phrasing.

shared_material.child_excerpt: There is hereby established the Commission ... The Commission shall be composed ... It shall be the function of the Commission ... All executive departments and agencies ... are authorized and directed to cooperate ... When the Commission deems that its work has been completed ... the Commission shall cease to exist.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: There is hereby established ... a commission ... which shall be composed ... The Commission shall make a thorough study ... All executive departments and agencies ... are authorized and directed to cooperate ... Thirty days after the presentation of its final report ... the Commission shall cease to exist.
shared_material.explanation: The directives use the same ordered administrative framework for creating, empowering, supporting, and dissolving a temporary presidential commission.
